name: Hof Walch
beschreibung: The Hof Walch is an inn in the village of Bach in the district of Reutte in Tirol. The accommodation offers rooms with traditional furnishings. The inn's restaurant serves regional dishes. The surroundings of the Lechtal are mountainous and wooded. Guests can hike or ski there. Free parking is available at the property. Wi-Fi is available throughout the building.
